question: Find the full names and colleges of members who are not regular 'Member' position holders, wear an 'X-Large' t-shirt, and have made at least one expense that exceeds the average cost of all expenses in the 'Advertisement' budget category.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m."XCL_035",
    m."XCL_036",
    mj."XCL_033"
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS mj ON m."XCL_042" = mj."XCL_030"
WHERE m."XCL_038" <> 'Member'
  AND m."XCL_039" = 'X-Large'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM expense AS e
      JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
      WHERE e."XCL_022" = m."XCL_034"
        AND e."XCL_020" > (
            SELECT AVG(e2."XCL_020")
            FROM expense AS e2
            JOIN budget AS b2 ON e2."XCL_023" = b2."XCL_003"
            WHERE b2."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
        )
  )
